Thomas Massie — that he started a relationship with Cynthia West shortly after his wife's death, arranged her a job in Rep. Victoria Spartz's office, that the relationship ended, she was fired, and the situation has since become an alleged hush-money story.

The original note injects a contested-but-not-clearly-wrong correction onto a tweet that's already roughly accurate. Raters flagged 'note not needed' (20) as the dominant tag. This is accurate-reporting-contested territory.
